sloka: च्यवनं भृगुपुत्रं च मुनिं चारिष्टनेमिनम् ।प्रमोदनं मोदकरं ततो दुर्वाससं मुनिम् ।। ७.९०.५ ॥
transliteration: cyavanaṁ bhṛguputraṁ ca muniṁ cāriṣṭaneminam ।pramodanaṁ modakaraṁ tato durvāsasaṁ munim ।। 7.90.5 ॥

translations.english: He also invited Chyavana, the son of Bhrigu, the sage Arishtanemi, Pramodana who brings joy, and then the sage Durvasas.
